Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Breast cancer

TEST PERFORMED
HER2 Gene Amplification by Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH)

METHODOLOGY
Interphase FISH analysis was performed on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue using the PathVysion HER2 DNA Probe Kit (Abbott Molecular). This FDA-approved dual-color probe set contains a SpectrumOrange-labeled probe specific for the HER2 gene locus (17q12) and a SpectrumGreen-labeled probe specific for the chromosome 17 centromere (SE17). Analysis was performed on 60 interphase nuclei and correlated with HER2 immunohistochemistry stained slides.

RESULTS
HER2 (17q12) gene copy number: 2.45 (mean)
Chromosome 17 centromere copy number: 2.08 (mean)
HER2/Chr17 ratio: 1.18
Number of cells analyzed: 60

INTERPRETATION
NEGATIVE for HER2 gene amplification

The HER2/Chr17 ratio of 1.18 is below the threshold of 2.0 for amplification. The mean HER2 gene copy number of 2.45 per cell is within normal limits. These findings are consistent with a HER2-negative breast cancer.

COMMENT
FISH analysis was performed in correlation with HER2 immunohistochemistry. According to ASCO/CAP 2018 guidelines, tumors with HER2/Chr17 ratio <2.0 and average HER2 copy number <4.0 signals/cell are classified as HER2 negative (ISH Group 5).
